brief: Zwei Helligkeitsstufen der ausgewählten Tuschezeichnung auf dem Seitenhintergrund #0d0f12. Gesichtszüge und neue Komposition beibehalten.

variants.title: Präsent
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Input image 1: the EDIT TARGET, the user's selected black and white dry-brush illustration of young Jackie Leven. Preserve his recognizable face EXACTLY: existing proportions and spacing of eyes, nose, lips, jaw and forehead, gaze, youthful age, expression, head angle, hairstyle and shoulder pose. This is the approved likeness. Do not turn him into another person or sharpen or lengthen his facial anatomy.
Primary request: reinterpret this same artwork as a rough, selective-light dry-brush portrait emerging organically from a solid very dark anthracite website background, RGB 13,15,18, hex #0d0f12.
The white paper background must completely disappear and be replaced everywhere by this deep anthracite. Hair and clothing shadows merge into that same darkness. Build the face with a limited number of large, matte gray pigment shapes. Keep its natural positive light/shadow relationships: the eyes, pupils, nostrils and mouth line stay DARK within lighter facial planes, not glowing white. NO photographic negative, NO simple color inversion, no skeletal contours.
The brushwork should be urgent and physical, with dry ragged broken edges. Form and likeness come from a few precise marks and flat value shapes, no photographic skin, no engraving, no delicate filigree or smooth airbrushed portrait. Fade the outer shoulders and lower chest organically into untouched anthracite with sparse dry brush traces. Reduce the big brush arc behind the head to a barely visible fragment; do not create a halo. Most hair stays dark, with only a few short muted rim strokes. Keep the face strong, youthful, rebellious and alert; not spectral, macabre, dreamy, romantic or elderly.
Vertical 4:5 format; same relative face scale and placement as the input but leave a small clean anthracite margin above and on both sides. Along ALL outer edges the background should settle into the plain exact #0d0f12 color with no paper grain, vignette frame, hard rectangular artwork boundary or border. No text, symbols, props, signature, watermark lettering or extra people. The term watermark refers only to tonal subtlety.

Variant A — PRESENT AND CLEAR: visible, forceful patches of muted warm-gray light on forehead, nose bridge, cheek and chin. Use approximately #a3a4a1 for the broad brightest pigment, #697076 for middle planes and #333a40 for sparse rim accents, all against #0d0f12. No white. The eyes and mouth must read at website size, giving a strong gaze. Approximately two-thirds of the total image remains dark or almost dark. Make the face present without a glaring bright cutout; allow some dark interruptions in the light planes. The shading remains visibly hand-painted and flat.
